summary: iOS anchor date tap fix — charts now show correct dates after auto-scroll.
whatsNew: Anchor Date Investigation charts now show the correct date when tapping any data point on iPhone — even after the chart auto-scrolls to center the anchor date on open.
fixes: Root cause of the iOS 'shows Feb dates when tapping Mar points' bug finally eliminated. iOS compositor desyncs scrollLeft reads after programmatic writes — fixed by caching scroll position in JavaScript instead of reading the unreliable DOM property.
